bounded_implementation_controls.requirement: Keep validation bounded before copying or traversing caller collections. For exact dict input, probe the fixed required keys and reject an extra-key cardinality using constant expected fields; do not iterate, sort, set-copy or serialize an arbitrarily large unknown-field dictionary merely to reject it. Preserve MISSING-before-UNKNOWN precedence.

Check collection type/length before any content traversal; check each edge length before indexed access and exact int type before range/comparison/indexing. Every auxiliary array/set/list and every loop bound must be justified by the contract maxima. No recursive DFS.

Check the entire dependency graph for cycles even with no seeds or cycles outside seed closure. A finite reachability scan alone is insufficient cycle evidence. For predecessor ordering, if no ready node exists before every admitted entry is emitted, return only P_CYCLE.
Return fresh dict/list output objects and preserve input values on success and every error. Retain all first mismatches/errors; component TESTED does not imply PROVED or whole checker acceptance.

predecessor_order selects the smallest currently ready index at each step. p_smallest_available_each_step expected [1,2,0,3] is consistent: roots 1 and 2 are initially ready; after 1, choose 2 over 3; after 2, choose newly ready 0 over 3.

Self-cycles, multivertex cycles, missing indices, bool/float indices, duplicate edges/changed indices, collection exhaustion and closed-field validation expectations agree with their declared precedence.
Graph and predecessor limits are fixed; exact builtin type checks exclude bool-as-int and integral floats. No recursion, hidden fetching or authority-bearing operation is required by either contract.
